questions.stemEn: A child has recurrent sinopulmonary infections, poor growth, and bronchiectasis on chest imaging. Which cell type is primarily affected in the disease process being tested?
questions.explanationAr: السؤال يركز على اضطراب mucociliary clearance. وجود recurrent sinopulmonary infections مع bronchiectasis يجعل الخلل في الجهاز الهدبي هو الفكرة الأساسية، وليس في Type II pneumocytes التي وظيفتها الأساسية تصنيع surfactant.
questions.reasoningEn: The source frames the item around impaired mucociliary clearance; ciliated airway epithelial cells are therefore the intended target rather than surfactant-producing type II pneumocytes.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Type II pneumocytes مرتبطة بإنتاج surfactant داخل alveoli، لذلك لا تفسر recurrent sinopulmonary infection مع bronchiectasis.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrent sinopulmonary infection with bronchiectasis should trigger consideration of CF and PCD.

questions.stemEn: A child with recurrent sinusitis and otitis media has nasal polyps on CT. Which test should be done next?
questions.explanationAr: وجود nasal polyps مع recurrent sinusitis وotitis media يرفع الاشتباه في cystic fibrosis. لذلك المصدر يختار Sweat chloride test كخطوة تالية قبل الانتقال لاختبارات PCD المتخصصة.
questions.reasoningEn: Nasal polyps are a strong clue for CF in this clinical context, so the source prioritizes sweat chloride testing.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Microscopic ciliary biopsy قد يدخل ضمن تقييم PCD، لكنه ليس الاختبار الأول المقصود في هذا السيناريو.
questions.clinicalPearl: Nasal polyps in a child with chronic sinopulmonary disease are an important clue to CF.

questions.stemEn: A 13-year-old girl has recurrent otitis media, sinusitis, and pneumonia. Cystic fibrosis was previously suspected, but two sweat chloride tests were negative. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: تكرار otitis media وsinusitis وpneumonia مع negative sweat chloride مرتين يجعل Primary ciliary dyskinesia أقرب من CF في صياغة المصدر.
questions.reasoningEn: Persistent upper and lower respiratory disease with repeatedly negative sweat testing shifts the differential toward PCD.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: CF أقل احتمالًا مع تكرار negative sweat testing، وceliac disease لا تفسر نمط recurrent sinopulmonary infections.
questions.clinicalPearl: PCD should be considered when chronic sinopulmonary disease persists after CF has been reasonably excluded.
diagnosticSteps: Structured PCD evaluation after CF exclusion

questions.stemEn: A 7-day-old infant with a family history of cystic fibrosis has a normal sweat chloride test. How should this result be interpreted?

options.text: Sweat chloride testing is not sufficiently reliable at 7 days of age
Testing should only be done after 6 months
Testing should only be done at 1 year
The infant does not have cystic fibrosis

questions.explanationAr: المصدر يؤكد أن العمر الصغير قد يجعل sweat testing غير حاسم. أفضل دقة تكون عندما يكون الرضيع على الأقل بعمر نحو أسبوعين ووزنه أكثر من 2 kg، لذلك normal result بعمر 7 أيام لا يكفي لنفي CF.
questions.reasoningEn: Very early sweat testing can be technically inadequate or inconclusive, so a normal result at 7 days should not be treated as definitive exclusion.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الانتظار إلى 6 أشهر أو سنة غير مطلوب، كما أن النتيجة الطبيعية المبكرة لا تنفي CF بشكل قاطع.
questions.clinicalPearl: Early sweat testing may be inconclusive; age and weight affect test reliability.
diagnosticSteps: Repeat sweat chloride testing at an appropriate age/weight if suspicion remains

questions.stemEn: A child with cystic fibrosis was well during the day while playing outside, then developed vomiting and decreased level of consciousness. What should be checked next?
questions.explanationAr: في CF قد يحدث excessive salt loss عبر العرق، خصوصًا مع heat stress، مما يسبب hypovolemia مع hyponatremia وhypochloremia وأحيانًا hypokalemic metabolic alkalosis. لذلك فحص electrolytes هو الخطوة المنطقية في هذا السيناريو.
questions.reasoningEn: Heat-associated salt loss in CF can produce clinically important electrolyte disturbance and altered consciousness.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: CT brain لا يكون الخطوة الأولى إذا كان السيناريو يوجه بوضوح إلى electrolyte disturbance بعد heat exposure.
questions.clinicalPearl: CF patients can develop salt-depletion alkalosis during heat exposure.
diagnosticSteps: Serum sodium, potassium, chloride and acid-base assessment

questions.stemEn: A child with difficult-to-control asthma has high IgE, eosinophilia, and a chest radiograph described as showing a finger-in-glove sign. Which finding supports allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis?

options.text: Productive cough with brown mucus plugs

questions.explanationAr: الملف نفسه يذكر أن episodic/frequent bronchial obstruction يدخل ضمن diagnostic criteria للـABPA، لكنه يذكر أيضًا أن productive cough with brown plugs علامة highly suggestive. لذلك لا نعتمد المفتاح النهائي قبل verification.
questions.reasoningEn: The source labels A as the recalled answer but explicitly notes that D is also highly suggestive, creating an answer-key ambiguity.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Sputum culture يعتبر supportive/secondary criterion في المصدر، وperipheral bronchiectasis أقل توافقًا من central bronchiectasis المرتبط تقليديًا بالـABPA.
questions.clinicalPearl: ABPA classically combines asthma, eosinophilia, elevated IgE, Aspergillus sensitization and central bronchiectasis/mucus plugging.

questions.stemEn: A child is diagnosed with allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis. Which treatment is preferred among the listed options?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يذكر أن الأساس في علاج ABPA هو systemic corticosteroids لتخفيف inflammation، بينما antifungal المستخدم عادة إذا أضيف يكون itraconazole أو voriconazole، وليس fluconazole كخيار قياسي في هذا السؤال.
questions.reasoningEn: The source identifies systemic corticosteroids as the main anti-inflammatory treatment and notes itraconazole/voriconazole as adjunctive antifungals.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Fluconazole ليس الـantifungal المذكور في المصدر كعلاج adjunctive المعتاد للـABPA.
questions.clinicalPearl: Treat ABPA inflammation with systemic corticosteroids; selected azoles may be added to reduce fungal burden.
managementSteps: Consider an appropriate oral azole when indicated

questions.stemEn: A full-term newborn develops severe respiratory distress shortly after birth. Two previous siblings died from the same illness. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: وجود severe neonatal respiratory failure مع وفاة siblings سابقين بنفس الصورة يوجه في المصدر إلى congenital form of pulmonary alveolar proteinosis، وهي قد تنتج من genetic defects في surfactant production أو clearance.
questions.reasoningEn: A recurrent familial neonatal respiratory-failure phenotype supports a congenital genetic pulmonary disorder such as PAP in the source framing.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Congenital herpes وmeconium aspiration لا يفسران عادة نمط تكرر الحالة نفسها في عدة siblings.
questions.clinicalPearl: Congenital PAP can present with severe neonatal respiratory failure and may have a genetic basis.
diagnosticSteps: Pulmonary evaluation with imaging and confirmatory testing as clinically appropriate

questions.stemEn: A 9-month-old former preterm infant who required prolonged intubation has had recurrent stridor since early infancy. An upper-airway image was referenced. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: الـclue الأساسي هو prolonged intubation في preterm infant ثم recurrent stridor، وهذا يوجه إلى acquired subglottic stenosis أكثر من laryngomalacia.
questions.reasoningEn: Prolonged neonatal intubation is a classic risk factor for acquired subglottic stenosis.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Laryngomalacia غالبًا congenital ويتميز عادة inspiratory stridor من early infancy دون ارتباط ضروري بتاريخ prolonged intubation.
questions.clinicalPearl: Recurrent stridor after prolonged intubation should raise concern for acquired subglottic stenosis.

questions.stemEn: A 6-year-old child develops episodic inspiratory stridor and respiratory distress shortly after starting exercise. Symptoms resolve rapidly with rest, and the voice changes during attacks. The child is normal between episodes. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: التمييز هنا عن asthma مهم: الأعراض inspiratory أكثر من expiratory، فيها stridor وتغير voice، تبدأ مبكرًا مع exercise وتنتهي بسرعة مع rest. هذا النمط يطابق paradoxical vocal fold dysfunction.
questions.reasoningEn: Abrupt exercise-triggered inspiratory symptoms, stridor and voice change with rapid resolution are classic clues for paradoxical vocal fold dysfunction.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Asthma غالبًا يسبب expiratory wheeze ولا يسبب voice change بهذه الصورة. Vascular ring وlaryngomalacia لا يتصفان عادة بنوبات exercise-triggered سريعة الزوال، وGERD لا يفسر النمط كاملًا.
questions.clinicalPearl: PVFD often mimics asthma but is characterized by inspiratory stridor, throat symptoms and abrupt onset/offset.
diagnosticSteps: Consider laryngoscopic confirmation during symptoms when available

questions.stemEn: A child has persistent shoulder pain after a sports injury, now with reduced movement. X-ray was described as showing a lytic lesion. Serum calcium and ACE are elevated. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: المصدر يربط lytic bone lesion مع elevated ACE وhypercalcemia بـosseous sarcoidosis. لكن ACE supportive وليس confirmatory، والتشخيص النهائي للـsarcoidosis يعتمد على tissue diagnosis عند الحاجة.
questions.reasoningEn: The combination of a lytic bone lesion, hypercalcemia and elevated ACE is used by the source to support osseous sarcoidosis.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: LCH وosteomyelitis قد يسببان lytic lesions، لكن elevated ACE مع hypercalcemia يدعم sarcoidosis في صياغة السؤال. Hyperparathyroidism قد يسبب bone lesions لكنه لا يفسر elevated ACE.
questions.clinicalPearl: ACE can support sarcoidosis but lacks sufficient specificity to confirm it.
diagnosticSteps: Confirm suspected sarcoidosis with appropriate tissue evaluation when clinically indicated

questions.stemEn: A 5-year-old child wakes frightened at night. Which finding supports nightmares rather than another parasomnia?

options.text: They occur in the first third of the night
They are not associated with other abnormalities

questions.explanationAr: Nightmares تحدث عادة خلال REM sleep وتكثر في الجزء المتأخر من الليل. هذا يميزها عن night terrors التي تظهر غالبًا في أول ثلث من النوم خلال NREM deep sleep.
questions.reasoningEn: REM association is the key distinguishing feature for nightmares in the source.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: الحدوث في first third of sleep يميل أكثر إلى night terrors، أما بقية الخيارات فلا تمثل العلامة الفارقة المطلوبة.
questions.clinicalPearl: Nightmares occur in REM and are usually remembered; night terrors occur earlier in NREM sleep and are typically not recalled.

questions.stemEn: A child goes to sleep at 8 p.m. and wakes crying at 4–5 a.m. No other details are provided. What is the most likely diagnosis?
questions.explanationAr: الملف نفسه وضع علامة استفهام على الإجابة لأنه لا توجد تفاصيل كافية. توقيت الحدث في آخر الليل يميل إلى nightmares بسبب زيادة REM في آخر الليل، لكن السؤال ناقص ويحتاج verification قبل النشر.
questions.reasoningEn: Late-night timing favors a REM-related nightmare, but the source explicitly marks the answer as uncertain because the vignette lacks distinguishing details.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Sleep terrors وconfusional arousals غالبًا تحدث في NREM وبشكل أبكر من الليل، لكن نقص المعلومات يمنع الحسم الكامل.
questions.clinicalPearl: Timing helps distinguish parasomnias, but recall, autonomic signs and arousability are also important.

questions.stemEn: A child has difficulty falling asleep and repeatedly asks the parents to swaddle him throughout the night. What is the most likely cause?
questions.explanationAr: الطفل يعتمد على condition محدد حتى يبدأ النوم أو يعود للنوم، وهنا swaddling. هذا يطابق sleep-onset association type of behavioral insomnia of childhood في شرح المصدر.
questions.reasoningEn: Dependence on a specific parent-provided condition for sleep onset is characteristic of behavioral insomnia of childhood, sleep-onset association type.
questions.incorrectOptionsAr: Depression لا يُستدل عليها من هذا السلوك وحده، وnight terrors هي نوبات parasomnia أثناء النوم وليست مشكلة في sleep initiation.
questions.clinicalPearl: Behavioral insomnia may arise when a child cannot initiate or resume sleep without a learned sleep association.
managementSteps: Behavioral sleep intervention and consistent bedtime routine
